aiTrainer.cue_go_deeper: Descends un peu plus — atteins ta profondeur
aiTrainer.cue_slow_down: Slow the descent — control the negative
aiTrainer.cue_flat_back: Keep a flat back — brace your core
aiTrainer.cue_bar_close: Keep the bar close to your body
aiTrainer.cue_full_range: Use a fuller range of motion
aiTrainer.cue_press_lockout: Lock out the press at the top
aiTrainer.cue_ribs_down: Ribs down — don't overarch your lower back
aiTrainer.cue_no_swing: Pas d’élan — garde le torse stable
aiTrainer.cue_pull_back: Pull the elbows back behind your torso
aiTrainer.cue_pull_higher: Pull higher — chin over the bar
aiTrainer.cue_pin_elbows: Garde les coudes collés au corps
aiTrainer.cue_lock_upper_arm: Lock the upper arm — only the forearm moves
aiTrainer.cue_to_shoulder_height: Raise to shoulder height — not past your ears
aiTrainer.cue_soft_elbows: Keep a soft fixed elbow bend
aiTrainer.cue_hips_level: Hips level — no sag, no pike
aiTrainer.cue_soft_lockout: Soft lockout — don't slam the knees
aiTrainer.cue_drop_back_knee: Drop the back knee a bit lower
aiTrainer.cue_hinge_not_squat: Hinge at the hips — don't squat it
aiTrainer.cue_press_together: Press the dumbbells slightly together at the top
aiTrainer.cue_lean_forward: Lean slightly forward for chest emphasis
aiTrainer.cue_dont_go_lower: Don't go lower — protect your shoulders
aiTrainer.cue_upper_arm_level: Keep the upper arm level with the floor
aiTrainer.cue_brace_core: Brace your core — don't let the hips sag
aiTrainer.cue_turn_side: Place-toi de profil et mets le téléphone à ~2 m
aiTrainer.cue_turn_front: Face the camera more toward the front
aiTrainer.cue_low_light: It's too dark — add light or move closer to a window
aiTrainer.cue_move_back: Step back so your full torso is in frame
aiTrainer.cam_flat_bench: Phone at chest height, ~2m away, slightly off-center (front-45°).
aiTrainer.cam_incline_bench: Phone at chest height, ~2m, front-45° to your incline bench.
aiTrainer.cam_decline_bench: Phone near hip height, ~2m, front-45° to the decline bench.
aiTrainer.cam_upright_bench: Phone at chest height, ~2m, straight in front for seated presses.
aiTrainer.cam_seated_chest_press: Frame your upper body from front-45°, ~1.8m away.
aiTrainer.cam_seated_shoulder_press: Front view at chest height, ~1.8m away.
aiTrainer.cam_pec_deck: Front view — shoulders and arms fully visible.
aiTrainer.cam_lat_pulldown: Front view at waist height so head-to-hips stay in frame.
aiTrainer.cam_seated_row: Side view at hip height, ~2.2m — we watch torso swing.
aiTrainer.cam_chest_supported_row: Side view — pad faces away from camera.
aiTrainer.cam_t_bar: Side view at hip height for your T-bar hinge.
aiTrainer.cam_bench_support_row: Side view of the working arm, ~2m away.
aiTrainer.cam_cable_station: Side or front-45° depending on the move — full torso in frame.
aiTrainer.cam_preacher_bench: Side view at elbow height so the pad and forearms are clear.
aiTrainer.cam_smith_rack: Side view ~2.5m — full squat depth visible.
aiTrainer.cam_hack_squat: Side view of the sled — hips to ankles in frame.
aiTrainer.cam_leg_press: Side view at knee height — we'll only track your legs.
aiTrainer.cam_leg_extension: Side view at knee height on the extension machine.
aiTrainer.cam_lying_leg_curl: Side view while lying — hips to ankles visible.
aiTrainer.cam_seated_leg_curl: Side view at knee height for seated curls.
aiTrainer.cam_standing_calf: Side view low — ankles must be sharp in frame.
aiTrainer.cam_seated_calf: Side view at ankle height for seated raises.
aiTrainer.cam_hip_thrust: Side view at hip height — upper back on the bench.
aiTrainer.cal_fair: We scale angles to your body so coaching stays fair across body types.
